statusRecovery.reason: Warm status formerly counted all SQL rows despite a valid complete connection cache. It now reuses counts only after exact header/version and durable corpus-token checks. Cold/stale status uses SQL counts without full load.
statusRecovery.scope: Fresh equivalent synthetic tail seed; no preceding edit prefix. Only status statistics supersede the full scan; unchanged tail windows remain recorded as scoped validation.
